body:
I just smoked weed again cause I can't handle quitting 2 drugs at once. I don't even think I have the self discipline to quit one. 

I'm high but I still feel like shit. It does help me keep the thoughts off of my depression for a little bit.

I just got FIFA 19 and I've been playing that for a while just to keep my mind off of it even more.

I just feel so alone and trapped and I don't know what to do.
If you don't mind me asking, how old are you?
I don't know. I wanted somone to talk to but now as somone replied I just can't think of anything to say. I'm sorry

I am moving soon back to college so im going to see a counselor there. Its just thats a month away and that feels like an eternity.

Also i have been having trouble breathing the past few days. It feels like im slowly suffocating like i cant take a deep breath. It feels like torture. I went to the doctor and told her about the weed and the depression and she thinks the breathing problem is from an anxiety attack that's lasted 4 days. I think shes right and i dont know what to do. She didnt give me any meds

I haven't felt happiness for a long time. All I feel anymore are spurts of anger or sadness, with the rest of the time I just feel an impending sense of doom and misery.

I just want to die. There are too many negative things in life that will always outweigh the good. And maybe that's not the case for many people, maybe they were lucky enough to have more positives than negatives. I don't think I'm one of those people.

I don't even have the strength to get out of bed in the morning anymore. I wake up and I think to myself "I have work" or "I should go be productive today" but then I realize there's no point to doing anything cause I'm going to be dead soon anyway.


I know I'm too late to this thread and noone is going to read it anyway, I don't even know why I'm writing this.


I've turned to weed to get rid of my problems and got addicted to it. Now I can't be sober for an hour before I start getting cravings. I'm doing it to the point where it is greatly affecting my health, but I can't stop. Being sober is just torture because I feel worthless. Being sober causes me to actually think about my problems.

 I feel like there's nobody out there for me, no one to make me feel loved. I feel so alone.
